_about: What each Poké Ball does, written from CFRU's GetBaseBallCatchOdds and ApplyBallSpecialEffect (src/catching.c). Multipliers apply to the Pokémon's catch rate. Keyed by CFRU's BALL_TYPE_* (the item table's type byte); every Poké Ball on the page needs an entry.
BALL_TYPE_LUXURY_BALL: 1x catch rate. The caught Pokémon makes friends faster: whenever its friendship goes up, it goes up 1 more.
BALL_TYPE_NET_BALL: 3.5x catch rate on Water and Bug types, 1x otherwise.
BALL_TYPE_DIVE_BALL: 3.5x catch rate while surfing, fishing or underwater, 1x otherwise.
BALL_TYPE_NEST_BALL: Better on low-level Pokémon: 4x at Lv 1, dropping 0.1x per level to 1.1x at Lv 30; 1x from Lv 31.
BALL_TYPE_REPEAT_BALL: 3.5x catch rate on species you've already caught, 1x otherwise.
BALL_TYPE_TIMER_BALL: 1x on the first turn, then +0.3x each turn, up to 4x from turn 11.
BALL_TYPE_DUSK_BALL: 3x catch rate at night or in caves, 1x otherwise.
BALL_TYPE_HEAL_BALL: 1x catch rate. The caught Pokémon is fully healed.
BALL_TYPE_QUICK_BALL: 5x catch rate on the first turn of battle, 1x after.
BALL_TYPE_FAST_BALL: 4x catch rate on Pokémon with base Speed 100 or more, 1x otherwise.
BALL_TYPE_LEVEL_BALL: Compares your Pokémon's level with the target's: 1x if not higher, 2x if higher, 4x if at least double, 8x if at least four times.
BALL_TYPE_LURE_BALL: 4x catch rate on Pokémon hooked with a fishing rod, 1x otherwise.
BALL_TYPE_HEAVY_BALL: Adjusts the catch rate by weight: −20 under 100 kg, +20 from 200 kg, +30 over 300 kg.
BALL_TYPE_LOVE_BALL: 8x catch rate on the opposite gender of your Pokémon's own species, 1x otherwise.
BALL_TYPE_FRIEND_BALL: 1x catch rate. The caught Pokémon starts with 200 friendship.
BALL_TYPE_MOON_BALL: 4x catch rate on the Nidoran, Clefairy, Jigglypuff, Skitty and Munna families, 1x otherwise.
BALL_TYPE_BEAST_BALL: 5x catch rate on Ultra Beasts, 0.1x on anything else. Every other ball is 0.1x on Ultra Beasts.
BALL_TYPE_DREAM_BALL: 4x catch rate on sleeping Pokémon (or ones with Comatose), 1x otherwise.
